_meta.description: Real, open US class-action settlements used as the MVP settlement catalogue. Each entry was read on its source page on 2026-10-06. Fields not confirmed on the source page are null.

match_rule_values.purchase_in_period: Evidence = a purchase/booking of the named product inside the class period
match_rule_values.account_in_period: Evidence = having an account / using the service inside the class period
match_rule_values.breach_notice: Evidence = the company's own data-breach notice to the user (period check not needed)
match_rule_values.dispute_in_period: Evidence = a dispute record with the company inside the class period
match_rule_values.excluded_sender_domains: Optional: evidence from these sender domains is never a match (same-name, different company)

settlements.name: Apple Intelligence Siri False Advertising Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: US residents who bought an iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max or any iPhone 16 model in the US between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025.
settlements.payout_note: $25 per device, adjusted pro rata; up to $95 if few people file

settlements.name: Amazon Returns Settlement ($309.5M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: Amazon customers whose refund for a returned product was missing, late, incorrect or charged back on or after September 5, 2017. Subclass A is paid automatically; Subclass B must file with the Notice ID.

settlements.name: CVS Digital Privacy Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: Anyone who used a CVS website, the CVS Health website or the CVS app in the US before July 27, 2026. A store visit alone does not count; one claim per household.
settlements.payout_note: Up to $5 with no documentation, up to $10 with proof such as dated screenshots

settlements.name: Dr. Squatch "Natural" Labels Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: People who bought Dr. Squatch personal care products labeled "natural" in the US between November 1, 2018 and August 29, 2026.
settlements.payout_note: $0.50 per product: 5 products on attestation, up to 25 with receipts

settlements.name: Levoit Air Purifier "HEPA" Labels Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: People who bought a Levoit Core or EverestAir air purifier or replacement filter labeled "True HEPA", "HEPA" or "H13" in the US between August 29, 2019 and August 4, 2023. Proof of purchase date required.
settlements.matching_note: Often bought through a retailer (e.g. Amazon), so match on the brand in the product line, not only the sender.

settlements.name: Thinkware Dash Cam Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: Drivers who bought a Thinkware X700, F200PRO, F70PRO, DC-M2-FG or DC-M2-FG-IR dash cam in the US between January 25, 2019 and August 31, 2024.
settlements.payout_note: About $6.70 per camera; one camera without a receipt
settlements.matching_note: Usually bought through a retailer (Best Buy, Amazon); match on brand + model in the product line.

settlements.name: Bestway Above-Ground Pools Settlement ($15M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: People who bought a Bestway-branded above-ground pool 48 inches or taller, with compression straps outside the support poles, sold between 2008 and 2024.
settlements.payout_note: $40 without a receipt, or 10% of the price with proof of purchase
settlements.matching_note: Source gives the sale window as years (2008–2024); exact start/end days are an assumption.

settlements.name: Flo Period Tracker Privacy Settlement ($59.5M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: US users who logged period or pregnancy data in the Flo app between November 2016 and February 2019. No Unique ID or PIN needed.
settlements.payout_note: Pro rata share of $59.5M; California residents may get a double share

settlements.name: TED Video Privacy Settlement (Sutton v. TED Foundation)
settlements.eligibility_summary: US TED account holders who watched a pre-recorded video on ted.com or the TED iOS/Android apps between October 19, 2021 and July 14, 2026.
settlements.payout_note: Two free months of membership (valued at $10+) automatically, or $5 cash with a claim
settlements.matching_note: Cash claim needs the 8-digit Claim ID and 4-digit PIN from the notice email.

settlements.name: MDLive Patient Portal Privacy Settlement ($3.5M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: MDLive users who signed in to patient.mdlive.com and used the portal between May 30, 2023 and August 11, 2025, and had an active Facebook or Google account then.
settlements.matching_note: Sources disagree on whether a Claimant ID is required (Top Class Actions: no proof; Open Class Actions: Claimant ID).

settlements.name: Equifax Hard Inquiry Dispute Settlement ($30M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: US residents who disputed one or more hard inquiries on their credit report with Equifax between Aug 31, 2021 and Mar 27, 2026 (General Dispute Group); a larger payment applies to some mailed disputes back to Oct 4, 2016.

settlements.name: Lands' End Data Breach Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: People affected by the December 2024 Lands' End data breach (those sent a notice). Login ID and PIN from the notice are required.
settlements.payout_note: About $60 with no receipts, or up to $5,000 documented, plus 2 years of monitoring

settlements.name: Equinox, Inc. Data Breach Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: US residents who were sent a notice by Equinox, Inc. (Albany, NY nonprofit health provider) that their information may have been affected in the data incident detected on or about April 29, 2024.
settlements.payout_note: Estimated $100 pro rata and/or up to $5,000 documented, plus up to 3 years of monitoring
settlements.disambiguation: NOT Equinox fitness clubs (equinox.com). This is Equinox, Inc., a nonprofit mental health services provider in Albany, NY. A gym membership email is NOT evidence.
settlements.matching_note: Name collides with Equinox fitness. Normalising strips 'inc', so match ONLY on a breach/settlement notice that names Equinox, Inc. or the Albany provider; drop anything from equinox.com.

settlements.name: Autobell Car Wash Data Breach Settlement
settlements.eligibility_summary: People notified of the April 2024 cyberattack on the Autobell Car Wash chain.
settlements.payout_note: $45 with no documentation, or up to $5,000 documented, plus 2 years of credit monitoring

settlements.name: Venetian Las Vegas Website Privacy Settlement ($1.6M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: California residents who booked a stay on venetianlasvegas.com, or browsed the site, while in California between September 18, 2024 and March 16, 2026.
settlements.payout_note: About $71.39 for bookers, about $3.60 for browsers
settlements.matching_note: State-restricted: confirm a California address (billing address in the email works).

settlements.name: Raging Waters Processing Fee Settlement ($850K)
settlements.eligibility_summary: US residents who bought admission tickets on ragingwaters.com between June 1, 2020 and June 22, 2026 and paid a "Processing Fee". Notice ID and Confirmation Code required.
settlements.payout_note: Pro rata share of about $483,000 net, calculated from Raging Waters' records

settlements.name: Kroger Prescription Pricing Settlement ($17M)
settlements.eligibility_summary: People in the US who paid anything toward a prescription filled with insurance at a Kroger-owned pharmacy between December 9, 2018 and August 23, 2026. Notice ID and Confirmation Code required.
settlements.payout_note: Pro rata share of $17M, weighted by amount paid
settlements.matching_note: Ralphs and Fred Meyer are Kroger banners; aliases are an assumption to confirm against the settlement's pharmacy list.
